audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read 'Skill' although whys[0] says Urgot bullies his low level-1 health, and row 6 read 'Skill' although whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say two items flip the 1v1 to Vladimir. Packet levelChart agrees: Urgot rows 0-5, Vladimir row 6.
audit.why: Urgot is 52.4% over 1189 games and owns every lane stage; Vladimir's Crimson Pact health/AP scaling and bottomless Transfusion take over once he has two items.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side/win[0] to Urgot (rating 6/10) and phases[6].side/win[6] to Vladimir (rating 3/10), with phases[6].why rewritten from an Urgot-favoured line to the real reason he loses that stage.

audit.why: Spikes are correct: Urgot at 3-5 and at level 6 into a low health bar; Vladimir at his first AP/health item and again at two-plus items with Hemoplague.
audit.corrected: Left spikes[1..3] alone; spikes[0].text edited only for the ability-name error and the untargetable interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real errors. (a) spikes[0].text writes 'Sanguine Pools' — the ability is Sanguine Pool. (b) breakdown/mid claims 'E-flip catches him even through Sanguine Pool if you time the recast': Sanguine Pool makes Vladimir untargetable for 2 seconds and Urgot's E has no recast, so this instructs the player to throw their engage into an untargetable window. Anti-heal is also never stated despite both his Q and R healing him.
audit.why: Kit text: Sanguine Pool = 'becoming untargetable for 2 seconds', cooldown 28/25/22/19/16. Transfusion (9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s) steals life and Hemoplague heals him per champion hit. Urgot's E is a 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s charge with no recast.
audit.corrected: Ability name fixed; the untargetable window now told as 'commit after it, not into it' with the 28s rank-1 cooldown; anti-heal named against Transfusion and Hemoplague; MR-over-raw-HP stated against Crimson Pact scaling.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Vladimir must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: Two items give him bottomless Transfusion healing and Hemoplague — you cannot duel him, so cash the early lead into objectives instead.

edits.before: Vladimir is weak and mana-less-but-fragile early: Q the ground under him, W-shred through his low base health, and E-flip him when he Sanguine Pools to deny the escape. Every level before his items is a bully phase for you.
edits.after: Vladimir is fragile and health-costed early: Q the ground under him, W-shred through his low base health, and hold E for after Sanguine Pool — its 2s untargetable eats anything you spend into it. Every level before his items is yours.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay heavily in your favour. Q slows him, W shreds his flimsy early body, and E-flip catches him even through Sanguine Pool if you time the recast. Land your level-6 R when he's low and he simply doesn't have the CC or burst to answer it — this is your kill window.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay heavily in your favour. Q slows him, W shreds his flimsy early body, and Sanguine Pool is down 28s at rank 1 — once he burns it he has no answer for 26 more seconds. Land your level-6 R when he's low and he has no CC or burst to stop it — that is your kill window.

edits.before: Dodges your shred. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable on 28s — commit after it, not into it.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him — Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His damage is magic and Crimson Pact scales it with health — buy MR, not raw HP.

notes: The 'E-flip catches him even through Sanguine Pool if you time the recast' line in content.mid was actively wrong advice — Pool is 2s of untargetability and Urgot's E has no recast. Removed. Whether Urgot's R impale persists or is cancelled if Vladimir Pools mid-flight is not in Riot's text; I did not assert either way, so no edit claims it.
